scope: Read-only source review and reading of committed historical/local evidence. No browser, test suite rerun, remote access, Actions access or artifact download. New official second-candidate artifact belongs to parent auditor.

naturalReturnSourceAssessment.observerPhase: window keydown capture, preceding unchanged production document keydown handler
naturalReturnSourceAssessment.observerBehavior: Reads performance.now, existing lastCapBubbleAt, DOM visibility/text and game state; records up to 2 KeyE snapshots but counts every KeyE; does not preventDefault or dispatch any event.
naturalReturnSourceAssessment.cleanup: finish called in finally, removes the capture listener, then global watch is deleted; JSON is saved even if the original input/closure wait fails.
naturalReturnSourceAssessment.nativeProductionChain: document KeyE -> game.toggleSoul -> recall -> capEvent(return) -> original onCapEvent 1600ms guard -> showCapLines updates lastCapBubbleAt and starts original 3800/5800ms timeout
naturalReturnSourceAssessment.newStrictVisibilityLocation: After actual native return has completed cap closure, before root crossing.
naturalReturnSourceAssessment.oldRootVisibilityRequirement: The v32-added unconditional require_bubble=True was removed at root-crossed. Layout remains captured; actor avoidance is checked only if the bubble is actually visible.
naturalReturnSourceAssessment.timingAndSamplingAreNotUnchanged: This is an explicit timing/sampling correction, not preservation of every v32 assertion at the same location.
naturalReturnSourceAssessment.geometryRead: DOM geometry, actual rig and renderer are read synchronously in one JS evaluation. The event-completion read, geometry read and following PNG are distinct observations.

targetedLocalEvidence.scope: One targeted local 1280x800 Chromium run: native first-station navigation then the complete existing greenhouse routine. No six-chapter/phone/ending/full-network result is claimed.

historicalSixConfigurationArchive.scope: Historical local first-station matrix plus separate full local route; not execution of ce412 or its official CI.
historicalSixConfigurationArchive.coexistenceScope: Original tutorial announcement fade-out with opening speech; later PNG can differ. No forced text/event or clock mutation.

limits: Source review and historical/local evidence are not the new official ce412 artifact audit.

The bodyIdentity field is absent from the new return clock record.
Old 5445 source snapshots do not contain the new clock probe and cannot prove its execution.

No longest theatre speech/large-font/high-platform/full-outfit or physical-device performance proof.

conclusion: No blocking source defect found. Preserve the explicit changed timing/sampling semantics, local/historical source attribution and body-identity wording limit.
